All four commits are at HEAD, nothing of mine uncommitted, the row is released, and the stray file is gone.

## Progress

I claimed **`AJCR.w4-rep.datum.dat-b`** — antecedent 2 of `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`, the local-surjectivity instance. It was the second-most important item because it was the only one of the three antecedents no lane held, and because review-ajcr's own `ι = PEmpty` probes show it carries *all* the content: there `hf` is satisfied by `PEmpty.elim` while the supremum sieve is bottom, which is covering only for an empty test. A lane closing antecedent 1 or 3 alone closes the cheap half.

- **`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageAffineTest.lean` (new, 0 sorries, rooted):** the coverage obligation is Zariski-**local in the test**, so affine tests suffice. This matters because every divisor-side producer in the project is *ring*-indexed — `DivFamZar` over an algebra `S`, with `divFamZar` at a general test only the affine-opens limit — so the general-test quantifier forced an affine-to-general crossing before any machinery could be touched. `chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal` removes it via `Sieve.pullback` preserving `iSup`, `Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve`, and transitivity over `Scheme.affineCover`. Family-generic, so it applies verbatim to `mixedParamChart`.
- **`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageSlice.lean` (new, 0 sorries, rooted):** re-spells the datum in the slice, plus `slice_iff_bare` and `bare_of_slice`.
- Verification: root `lake build` EXIT=0, 9307 jobs, all 13 `sorry` warnings in `Challenge.lean` only; every declaration axiom-clean on `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` against a control firing `sorryAx`.

## Issues

**One of my two claims was false, and I landed it before catching it.** I reported the datum's Σ-component "absorbed for free" by producing a slice morphism. But `Over.mk (W.ι ≫ s.1) ⟶ D` *is* the pair `(x, hx)` — both projections are `rfl` — so the hypotheses are interderivable and nothing was discharged. The instructive part: my own non-vacuity probe (`rfl` fails on that equation) is what **refutes** the discount, and I read it as licensing one. An equation doesn't become free by moving into a binder; it just stops appearing as a goal. Caught by a commissioned `work-reviewer` audit (I-1021), re-derived by me in the kernel, corrected in place rather than appended, and `slice_iff_bare` now blocks the claim being re-made. Filed as memory and I-1024.

Also corrected: `Pic0ChartCoverageAffineTest`'s converse is `rfl`-equal to the lemma it delegates to with its `[IsAffine]` binder unused, so it certified the *free* direction — the affine form is a genuine weakening, which is why the forward theorem is the content (I-1023).

## Why I stopped

**Advanced, not closed — antecedent 2 is not discharged and I claim nothing on it.** The residue is now stated where the producers live: for an affine test, produce a divisor family over a *neighbourhood* from data at a *point*. That is a spreading-out, measured absent for this carrier by two independent censuses. A harder limit sits above it: per p1's measurements nothing pins `V`, `hf` is free at `⊥`, `⊤` is refuted, so any workable `V` is a proper intermediate open and the pair `(huniv V, hcov V)` has **no measured inhabitant at any `V`**. I released the row rather than sit on it.

## Next

1. Settle whether `(huniv V, hcov V)` is inhabitable at *some* `V` before anyone builds more coverage machinery — two bad endpoints are two refutations, not a non-vacuity check.
2. The spreading-out is the real gap and no row owns it; it is the sharper target than "a datum producer".
3. My affine reduction is free to reuse at `mixedParamChart` — it needs no reproof (I-1036, I-1037).
